a: Time on ASKAP, ATCA, Murriyang (Parkes), Tidbinbilla 70-m/34-m and the Long Baseline Array (as offered for 2026OCT), through OPAL with dual-anonymous review.
dt: The 2026OCT deadline was 07:00 UT, 16 June 2026. ATNF's guide (dates approximate): APR-semester proposals open mid-November, deadline mid-December, observations start 1 April.
e: CSIRO runs its radio telescopes as national facilities and allocates time 'to astronomers around the world on scientific merit', in two semesters a year.
n: ATNF Call for Proposals, 2027APR semester (ASKAP, ATCA, Murriyang/Parkes, LBA)
unv: The exact 2027APR deadline is not yet announced, and the dates on the page are approximate. Grad-student PI status was not checked.
